name: Marukan Genuine Brewed Rice Vinegar (Mild Acidity)
whyItWorks: Slowly brewed from select rice with an acidity of only 4.1% (compared to 6–7% for harsh red wine or cider vinegars). Gentle on stomach acid and esophagitis while brightening Asian dishes.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Use a teaspoon to season sushi rice or mix with tamari and sesame oil for a delicate dipping sauce.
